Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Enable_tooltip: Survivors spawn from the map's spawn towns, persist across sessions, and act whether or not you are nearby.\nTurn off for a world without them.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_PopulationGove: Off: the population is sized automatically from the installed map\n(about 18 per spawn town, roughly 216 on the full map, so map mods add people automatically).\nOn: the number below is used instead.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Population_too: The number of living survivors maintained, used only when manual population is on.\nOnly nearby survivors have live bodies; the rest are simulated at low cost.\nAn existing world keeps the number it was created with and refills toward it over time.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_NewcomersGover: Off: the county can grow to three times the population as newcomers arrive.\nOn: the limit below is used instead.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Newcomers_tool: The maximum total population reachable through newcomer arrivals, used only when the manual limit is on.\nSet at or below the population to stop newcomer arrivals entirely.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadTraffic_to: How many people arrive together in a newcomer group. Groups arrive roughly once a month.\nWhether they settle depends on the county's wars, creeds, and season.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadPressureSt: How much the wait between newcomer groups shortens as the game goes on.\nAt None, arrivals stay about a month apart for the whole game.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_MaterializeRad: Survivors within this many tiles of you get a live body in the world.\nSurvivors farther away are simulated without a body.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HibernateRadiu: Live survivors farther than this many tiles from you return to simulation at their current position.\nKeep it comfortably above the presence radius, or survivors will appear and disappear repeatedly at the boundary.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays: Days before replacement after a death
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays_too: After a death, the county waits this many in-game days before a new survivor can spawn at a spawn town\n(never at the death site, never near you). At 0, replacement is immediate.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Desperation_to: The hunger or thirst level above which survivors take claimed food and water and ignore objections.\nLower values mean they take sooner; at the maximum they never take.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_TrustToCompany: The mutual trust level required before two survivors travel together (a trusted third can join).\nLower values form groups more easily.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadMeetingWor: What a road meeting is worth

How much trust two survivors build each time they cross paths on the road.\nAt the default (0.02) the companionship line takes about twenty-five meetings - weeks of crossing paths, never one conversation.\nAt zero a meeting builds nothing; higher builds trust faster.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_OpennessHorizo: Months until company becomes a need

How many months into the collapse before a lonely survivor's need for company can carry the whole companionship line.\nThe default is the ruled half year: a county six months into collapse is one where being alone is what kills you.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DriveSpeedCap_: The fastest a survivor drives a claimed car on a venture.\nThe default is 30, the figure carried whole from Week One with credit - their town-driving speed, read off the real speedometer.\nHigher drives faster; the engine's own brake at unloaded space stands at any speed.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Voice_tooltip: Survivors say short lines at meaningful moments: fleeing, warnings, thanks, grief.\nOff: identical behavior, no lines.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DayZero_toolti: The county starts before the outbreak: no fear, no losses, no learned lessons yet.\nPairs well with low zombie counts and slow turning.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_WeekOneNuke_to: Off by default. On, this world's strike is drawn once: the day, the towns, how many, how wide.\nThe countdown runs on the fall's own calendar, whenever it came to this county. The same save carries one fate; a new county is a novel apocalypse.\nAfter the strike the fire burns what fire burns and the fallout rises where the circles hold. Off: nothing of it runs at all.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_WeekOneBodyMod: SAO native bodies are the default. After a safe handoff, the same person continues with their history, relationships, appearance and belongings.\nLightweight source proxies delay that physical handoff for lower powered PCs. Existing people keep their recorded transition state.\nThis choice does not change your character or scenario.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RealSmoking_to: On by default. A smoker who is not in withdrawal still takes a smoke break now and then - a few a day, at their own pace.\nOff: a smoker only lights one up when the craving bites, and no other time.\nThe dial moves nobody's habit: who smokes is a fact about the person either way.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Telemetry_tool: Writes events (lessons learned, deaths, daily summaries) to SAO_telemetry.jsonl in your Zomboid folder.\nHas no effect on gameplay. Turn off if you do not want the file.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DormantRisk_to: Death risk multiplier for survivors outside the loaded area.\n0 disables off-screen deaths. 1 matches the danger near you. Higher values are deadlier.\nRisk is reduced by learned lessons, group membership, and a hardened past.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HoldNeighbourP: Suppresses overhead messages and narration from other survivor mods.\nHeld messages are counted on the County Ledger and released when this is turned off.\nThe same messages can usually also be disabled in those mods' own options.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RestoreTakenZo: Restore zombies taken by survivor spawns
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_NeighbourBridg: Take over another survivor mod's people

Off, this mod runs nothing through another survivor mod. It still never treats that mod's people as enemies.
On, and if such a mod is installed, its people become this mod's people.
They get the same memory, temperament and history everyone here has, and their own menu carries this mod's options.
Turning this on makes this mod call the other mod's code. Leave it off unless you want the two joined.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RecordOnCalend: Date broadcasts and newspapers by the calendar

The game's radio and TV schedule and its dated newspapers follow the in-game date instead of counting from the day the world began.
The Knox Event schedule starts July 9, 1993.
A world that starts earlier receives it from that date; a world that starts later receives it already in progress.
Newspapers show the newest issue printed by the current date.
Off: the schedule counts from the day the world began and newspapers are dated at random, as in the unmodded game.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RestoreTakenZo:
Each survivor spawn removes one nearby zombie, so the population is exchanged rather than added.
On: the county places one replacement zombie on distant town ground for each one taken, a few per day, never near you.
The map keeps the total it had, moved to where people crowded.
Off: taken zombies stay gone. The running balance is kept either way, so turning this on later repays gradually.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Branching_tool: The county keeps a record of what pressure each survivor is under and where their life is heading.\nOff: survivors still perceive, decide, group and settle exactly the same - nothing is written to the record.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Pressure_toolt: Threat, needs, injury, weather and the rest are summed into the record each pass.\nOff: the pressure sums are not kept.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Labor_tooltip: Repeated work - cooking, foraging, watching, treating - is counted toward the trades people end up known by.\nOff: work still happens, but is not counted.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Organization_t: When a house settles an election, accepts a chair, takes an order, or forms a pact, the fact is recorded as the organization it is.\nOff: houses still form and leaders still lead - none of it is recorded as organization.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Settlement_too: A settlement requires completed place work on claimed ground. Using supplies can refresh its store; it cannot found one.\nOff: none is recorded.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_PlayerInteract: Your petitions, refusals and offices are recorded against the county's organizations.\nOff: your asks still land - they are not recorded.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Material_toolt: After a survivor uses an item source on held ground, what remains can count as house stores.\nShelving is not connected yet.\nOff: nothing is counted.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Communication_: Grudges, credits and news passed between survivors are recorded as messages.\nOff: the words still pass - nothing is written down.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Neuroinflammat: Infection, sepsis, and drug toxicity produce a continuous brain inflammatory load affecting cognitive clarity and memory.\nOff: survivors do not experience inflammatory brain fog or memory degradation.

Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_BladderNeedMultiplier: Values below 1.0 decrease the rate, set it to 0 stop the need from increasing.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_HygieneNeedExpectatio: How many survived days it takes for a new survivor to care about hygiene.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_CleansMakeup_tooltip: Whether or not showering and bathing cleans body and facial makeup.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_NotEmbarrassed_toolti: Characters won't mind having others around while bathing or using the toilet.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_CleanClogged_tooltip: Toilets and other fixtures can be cleaned even while clogged.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_ColdSeverity_tooltip: How weak or strong the sickness from low hygiene can be.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_ColdChanceMultiplier: Hygiene - Low Hygiene Sickness Chance Multiplier

Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_OuthouseRange_tooltip: XY distance in tiles occupied by each outhouse.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_CleaningExpectationTi: How many survived days it takes for a new survivor to care about their surroundings.
Sandbox_LS_Hygiene_CleaningLitterChance_: Chance for an unskilled character to generate waste during a skill-based activity (e.g. food scraps from cooking with low cooking skill).
Sandbox_LS_Art_GeneralBeautyMultiplier_t: Modifies the default beauty value of all tiles, except player artworks.
Sandbox_LS_Art_BeautyOutdoors_tooltip: Whether or not beauty need can drop to negative levels when outdoors.
Sandbox_LS_Art_BeautyShowNegative_toolti: Whether or not negative beauty scores can appear above outdoor tiles (will always appear if ugly outdoors is enabled).
Sandbox_LS_Art_BeautyNeedDecayRate_toolt: The rate at which beauty needs decreases when around ugly or neutral environments.
Sandbox_LS_Art_BeautyNeedStrength_toolti: How strong the effects on mood from satisfying or neglecting a character's beauty need are.
Sandbox_LS_Art_ArtworkBeautyMultiplier_t: Values below 1.0 lower the effect of artworks on beauty score.
Sandbox_LS_Ambt_Cooldown_tooltip: The number of in game hours that must pass before a player can toggle on or off a recently activated/deactivated ambition again.
Sandbox_LS_Ambt_MaxInProgress_tooltip: The maximum number of incomplete ambitions players can activate and pursue. Passive ambitions are excluded.
Sandbox_LS_Ambt_MaxTotal_tooltip: The maximum number of ambitions players can activate overall, including both completed and in-progress ambitions.
Sandbox_LS_Ambt_ResetException_tooltip: Whether or not resets after editing ambitions' goals apply for players currently working towards them. Forced resets still apply for everyone.
Sandbox_LS_Ambt_HideTips_tooltip: Hidden ambitions won't display clues on how to unlock them.
Sandbox_LSDivider_Other_tooltip: This is only a line separator, checking it has no effect.
Sandbox_LS_DynamicTraits_tooltip: Whether or not traits can be lost or gained dynamically.
Sandbox_LS_DynamicTraitsReverse_tooltip:
Whether or not positive traits can be lost when DLT is enabled.
- Never: will never lose positive traits
- Always: can lose any lifestyle trait
- Dynamic only: can only lose traits gained dynamically, will never lose positive traits picked during character creation
Sandbox_LS_Comfort_ComfortNeedMultiplier: Values below 1.0 decrease the rate, set it to 0 to stop the need from increasing.
Sandbox_LS_Comfort_ComfortToggle_tooltip: Check to disable comfy chairs and beds giving positive comfort.
Sandbox_LS_Comfort_ComfortNoImpact_toolt: Check to stop Lifestyle's Comfort need from impacting vanilla's Discomfortable moodle.
Sandbox_LS_Divider_Server_tooltip: This is only a line separator, checking it has no effect.
Sandbox_LS_Server_ModdataUpdate_tooltip: How often in game time player moddata is updated. Do not change this if you don't know what this is.
Sandbox_LS_Server_MoodUpdate_tooltip: How often in game time changes to mood are applied. Only affects passive mood gain/loss (not timed actions)
Sandbox_Divider_Debug_tooltip: This is only a line separator, checking it has no effect.
Sandbox_Debug_MoodlePriority_tooltip: Enabling this will cause other modded moodles to appear above lifestyle moodles.
Sandbox_Debug_Expressions_tooltip: Enables manual expressions in the admin context menu
Sandbox_Debug_DanceAnim_tooltip: Enabling this will make animation names appear above some of the new animations
Sandbox_Art_tooltip: Rate at which Art skill levels up.
Sandbox_Cleaning_tooltip: Rate at which Cleaning skill levels up.
Sandbox_Dancing_tooltip: Rate at which Dancing skill levels up.
Sandbox_Meditation_tooltip: Rate at which Meditation skill levels up.
Sandbox_Music_tooltip: Rate at which Music skill levels up.
Sandbox_NewMusic_MaxTrackingRange_toolti: Determines how far each client retains tracking for active devices. Set to 0 for infinite range.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ActiveDeviceLimit_toolt: Hard cap on actively synced/playback-managed devices per client.
Sandbox_NewMusic_BatteryDrainRate_toolti: How fast the battery drains in real life hours.
Sandbox_NewMusic_AudioMaxRadius_tooltip: How far, in tiles, world playback devices can be heard at max volume.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ZombieAttractionRadius_: How far, in tiles, zombies are attracted to devices playing at max volume. Attraction range scales down with volume.
Sandbox_NewMusic_FancyUI_tooltip: Enable experimental UI for supported devices.
Sandbox_NewMusic_Disassembly_tooltip: Enables disassembly and scrap for New Music devices.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ZomboidOST_tooltip: Allows the base mod Zomboid OST items to spawn. Uncheck to disable them.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ConvertVanillaCDsAndCDP: Replace Vanilla CDs and CD Players
If enabled, vanilla CDs and CD players are replaced by New Music versions.
Sandbox_NewMusic_MediaSpawnsWithCases_to: If enabled, cassettes, vinyl records, and CDs can spawn inside their case, cover, or jacket items (if one exists).
Sandbox_NewMusic_CassettesSpawnPreset_to: Preset rarity for cassettes. Choose Custom to use the numeric Cassettes Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CassettesSpawnRate_tool: Controls cassette media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_VinylRecordsSpawnPreset: Preset rarity for vinyl records. Choose Custom to use the numeric Vinyl Records Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_VinylRecordsSpawnRate_t: Controls vinyl media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDsSpawnPreset_tooltip: Preset rarity for CDs. Choose Custom to use the numeric CDs Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDsSpawnRate_tooltip: Controls CD media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_WalkmanSpawnPreset_tool: Preset rarity for walkman devices. Choose Custom to use the numeric Walkman Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_BoomboxSpawnPreset_tool: Preset rarity for boombox devices. Choose Custom to use the numeric Boombox Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDPlayerSpawnPreset_too: Preset rarity for CD players. Choose Custom to use the numeric CD Player Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_RecordPlayerSpawnPreset: Preset rarity for record players. Choose Custom to use the numeric Record Player Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_AnnouncementLangua: Allows you to select the language used for announcements, such as when a new high score is achieved on the Punching Machine.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_DisableDefaultPriz: If enabled, the claw machine will NOT load built-in prizes (only addons / external prizes).
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_ReplaceVanillaArca: Replace vanilla arcade on world load
Replaces vanilla arcade machines with a random Project Arcade arcade when the map loads.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_ReplaceVanillaPinb: Replace vanilla pinballs on world load
Replaces vanilla pinball machines with a random Project Arcade pinball when the map loads.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_SfxVolumePct_toolt: Controls the volume of Project Arcade sound effects (0-100%%). Does not affect vanilla game audio. If you are ingame, must reload.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_CurrencyFullType_t: Example: Base.SilverCoin. If different than Base.SilverCoin, Project Arcade won't inject default coin spawns.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_CoinDistContainers: 0 disables. 100 is default. Higher values increase spawn rates.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_CoinDistZombiesPct: 0 disables. 100 is default. Higher values increase spawn rates.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_ROMDistPct_tooltip: 0 disables. 100 is default. Higher values increase spawn rates.
Sandbox_ProjectArcade_DisableArcadeAmbie: Disable arcade machine ambient sound (Attract Mode)
Disables only the cosmetic passive sounds on some machines
Sandbox_FWOFitness_InitialPerkBonus_tool: If enabled, XP gain speed also reflects your character's starting trait bonus for this skill (e.g. Weak/Strong for Strength): 75%% with a penalty trait, 100%% normal, 125%% with a bonus trait.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRegula: Grants a bonus or penalty to XP for the exercise you just did, based on how regularly you've been training it. Strength depends on the Offset and Rate options below.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseOffset: The regularity percentage (0-100) at which the Current Exercise Regularity Bonus is neutral. Training this exercise more regularly than this gives bonus XP; less regularly gives a penalty.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRate_t: How strongly regularity above or below the Offset affects XP for this exercise. Higher values mean bigger bonuses for consistent training and bigger penalties for inconsistent training.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_AverageExerciseRegula: Bonus XP based on how regularly you train across ALL exercises combined, not just the one you're currently doing.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_LevelBonus_tooltip: Extra XP multiplier added per perk level already gained in this skill. Example: at Level 5 with a value of 0.30, you get +150%% bonus XP.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExercise_tool: Applies an XP penalty if you train the same muscle group again too soon (while still sore from the last session, roughly within 8 in-game hours). Tracked separately for Fitness and Strength.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExerciseNegat: XP multiplier applied when the Space Out Exercise penalty is active (e.g. 0.90 = 10%% less XP).
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonus_tooltip: Applies an XP penalty while you still have ongoing muscle soreness from a previous workout. No penalty once the soreness has worn off.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonusNegative_t: XP multiplier applied while the Rested Bonus penalty is active due to muscle soreness (e.g. 0.90 = 10%% less XP).
Sandbox_FWOFitness_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies all XP gained from this mod's bonuses on top of vanilla XP. 1.0 = normal; use small steps (e.g. 1.1, 0.9) to fine-tune the pace.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_PassiveMultiplier_too: Controls how much this mod's bonuses affect XP gained OUTSIDE of active exercise, e.g. from fighting or sprinting. Set to 0 to disable passive XP changes entirely.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_BoredomMultiplier_too: Multiplier for how much exercise reduces Boredom. Set to 0 to disable this mod's boredom reduction.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_UnhappynessMultiplier: Multiplier for how much exercise reduces Unhappiness. Set to 0 to disable this mod's unhappiness reduction.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_KeepBagsOn_tooltip: Keep worn backpacks and bags equipped during exercise instead of automatically removing them first.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_DropBags_tooltip: When bags are automatically removed for exercise, drop them on the floor instead of keeping them in your inventory. Has no effect if Keep Bags Equipped is on.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_FitnessXPMul: Multiplier for the Fitness XP earned from treadmill exercise. 1.0 = normal. Requires a game/server restart to take effect for characters who have already exercised this session.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_StrengthXPMu: Multiplier for the Strength XP earned from weighted treadmill training and benchpress reps. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_SprintingXPM: Multiplier for the Sprinting XP earned from treadmill cardio sessions. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_HeatMultipli: Multiplier for the body heat you generate while exercising (0 = no heat gain, 1 = normal, 2 = double heat gain).
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_ThirstMultip: Multiplier for the thirst you build up while exercising (0 = no thirst gain, 1 = normal, 2 = double thirst gain).
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_TreadmillDro: When a bag is automatically removed before using the treadmill, drop it on the floor instead of keeping it in your inventory. Has no effect if Keep Bags Equipped is on.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchpressDr: When a bag is automatically removed before using the benchpress, drop it on the floor instead of keeping it in your inventory. Has no effect if Keep Bags Equipped is on.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchTreadKe: Keep worn backpacks and bags equipped during treadmill and benchpress exercise instead of automatically removing them first.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FreeTanks_tooltip: Who can place an aquarium from the right-click menu without an Empty Aquarium item. The server checks this on every placement. Tanks from found or packed Empty Aquarium items can always be placed.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortEnabled_tool: A stocked, watered tank slightly lowers unhappiness, boredom and stress for players standing near it. Untick to turn this off entirely; placing, stocking and viewing tanks is unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortRange_toolti: How close a player must be to a stocked tank to get the stress relief, in tiles (roughly the same room).
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortMaxTanks_too: How many nearby tanks can contribute before the benefit stops increasing, so a room lined with aquariums is not a bigger bonus than a couple of tanks.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FishSurviveMinMinut: How many real-world minutes a freshly caught fish survives out of water at 0 Fishing skill, before it must reach a tank.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FishSurviveMaxMinut: How many real-world minutes a freshly caught fish survives out of water at 10 Fishing skill, before it must reach a tank.
